name: Hydraulic Torrent
window: During the "Assign Hits" step
text: You may discard up to 2 Action Cards and produce that many additional hits.

name: Riptide Rush
window: After you activate a system
text: You may discard 2 Action Cards; apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

name: Flow Control
window: Before you assign hits produced by another player's unit ability roll
text: You may discard 1 Action Card; cancel 1 of those hits.

name: Rising Tide
window: At the start of a combat round
text: You may discard 1 Action Card; apply +1 to the result of each of your units' combat rolls during this combat round.

name: Hydrostatic Barrier
window: Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat
text: You may discard 1 Action Card; cancel up to 2 hits.

name: Ebbing Flow
window: At the start of a combat round
text: You may discard 1 Action Card; move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw.

name: Tides of Creation
window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
text: You may discard any number of Action Cards. Apply +2 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1 for each Action Card discarded.

name: Tidal Influence
window: When an agenda is revealed
text: You may discard 1 Action Card; choose another player. That player must give you 1 Promissory Note from their hand.

name: Tidal Bounty
window: ACTION
text: Discard any number of Action Cards; place 1 neutral unit in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships with a cost up to the number of Action Cards discarded.

name: Charted Currents
window: ACTION
text: Discard 3 Action Cards. Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card without spending a command token.

name: Contamination
window: When another player plays an Action Card
text: You may discard 3 Action Cards; cancel that Action Card.
